objective: Redesign the next chart-ready trigger with the two prior P3 rejection decisions supplied as resolved SOURCE evidence. Return exactly three machine-checkable semantically distinct triggers using finalized adjusted daily OHLCV only. Each trigger must define one shared scalar state and an explicit threshold crossing of that same state from D-1 to D. Closed price-MA and price-above-prior/rolling-high semantics are forbidden even if algebraically renamed. Select exactly one rank-1 candidate. Do not write code, run experiments, invent acceptance thresholds, infer participant behavior, or claim profitability. In DISCOVERY_CONTRACT, parameter names and ranges belong only in parameterSearch; notes must not repeat threshold or any coordinator-owned acceptance/gating language.
requiredOutputs: Exactly three PROPOSAL findings. Each claim must use exactly: CANDIDATE|featureId=<UPPER_SNAKE_ID>|family=<UPPER_SNAKE_FAMILY>|name=<short name>|state=<one scalar formula evaluated identically for each day>|prevTest=<exactly D-1 state <= threshold OR D-1 state >= threshold>|currTest=<exact opposite crossing on D>|fields=<OHLCV/derived inputs>|params=<bounded parameter family>|warmup=<minimum bars>|chart=<marker/overlay semantics>|densityRisk=<brief risk>|distinct=<why semantically independent from closed triggers>. Do not use pipe inside values.
The three featureId values and three family values must each be unique.
state must not contain D or D-1 labels; lag belongs only in prevTest/currTest.
Allowed transition pairs are only prevTest=D-1 state <= threshold with currTest=D state > threshold, or prevTest=D-1 state >= threshold with currTest=D state < threshold.
state may use OHLCV and deterministic rolling mean/range/location/gap/volume transforms, but may not encode close crossing/reclaiming a price MA or close crossing a prior/rolling high.
Summary must begin exactly RANK1|featureId=<one candidate>|reason=<only falsifiability, simplicity, chart traceability, or data availability rationale>.
nextActions must contain exactly one item: DISCOVERY_CONTRACT|featureId=<same rank-1>|parameterSearch=<bounded family>|notes=<implementation-independent notes>. Coordinator owns ranking and gates.

In DISCOVERY_CONTRACT, put all parameter names, ranges, and search bounds only in parameterSearch. The notes value must not contain threshold, acceptance, reject if, pass if, win-rate, win rate, positivePct, negativePct, >=, <=, or %. notes may describe only implementation-neutral execution such as deterministic computation or chart traceability.

sourceInputIds may use only these literal IDs: explorer-ma-cross, explorer-price-reclaim-high-breakout, daily-candle-contract, trigger-context-boundary, p3-reject-001, p3-reject-002. Never put a file path, artifactRef, decisionId, goalId, or dependsOn value in sourceInputIds.
Use p3-reject-001 and p3-reject-002 when citing the frozen negative design evidence; do not spell their repository paths in sourceInputIds.
No market participant, institutional, catalyst, support/resistance narrative unless directly supported by a resolved SOURCE; prefer mechanical language.
